name: stature
description: Build pipeline for the Stature WordPress theme. Sources live in src/; Parcel minifies them back into the paths WordPress serves (assets/ and each block's style.css), so no PHP or block.json changes are needed.

scripts.package: npm run build && mkdir -p dist && ( cd .. && rm -f stature/dist/stature.zip && zip -rqX stature/dist/stature.zip stature -x 'stature/node_modules/*' 'stature/src/*' 'stature/dist/*' 'stature/.git/*' 'stature/.claude/*' 'stature/.parcel-cache/*' 'stature/_design/*' 'stature/package.json' 'stature/package-lock.json' 'stature/.gitignore' 'stature/*.zip' '*/.DS_Store' '*.log' ) && ls -lh dist/stature.zip
